Keep the Study, primary family, five source-data StudyParts, purposes, and source conflicts. Add a separate InstrumentUse for QID-12 with CURRENT_STUDY_OBJECT context and DEVELOPMENT_OBJECT function. Retain the existing QID-12 measurement-property use as a second scientific use. Change iu2 source_label from “QI-Disability 32-item total score” to the exact instrument name “Quality of Life Inventory – Disability (QI-Disability)”; keep COMPARATOR as its function and describe the 32-item total score in the outcome or finding. Expand psa1, or add a source-faithful product-content finding, with all 12 retained items and their domains from Table 2: Physical health—“Had enough energy to participate in routines and activities” and “Slept well through the night”; Positive emotions—“Been in a good mood,” “Smiled or brightened their facial expression,” and “Showed happiness through body language”; Negative emotions—“Appeared upset or angry”; Social interactions—“Appeared relaxed when making eye contact”; Leisure and the outdoors—“Enjoyed feeling steady or stable during physical activities,” “Enjoyed physical activities,” and “Enjoyed going on outings in the community”; Independence—“Made their own choices for activities or things they enjoy” and “Helped to complete routine activities.” Also add the main Genetic Algorithm specification to psa1 or an equivalent source-faithful method description: 12 retained items, 500 runs with different seed values, selection by frequency among the 500 optimum solutions, at least one item from each domain, and no more than three items from a domain.

Revise lim2. Remove the invented claim that school-hours administration could affect coverage of adolescents with severe health problems. Use the source-faithful statement: “Because the survey was administered during school hours, the authors questioned whether the two adolescents who reported ‘a lot of’ problems in all EQ-5D-Y-3L dimensions could attend school; both adolescents also rated their self-reported health as ‘very bad’.” Keep the locator at Discussion, paragraph 6. No other material repair is needed.

In DataUse du2, change data level from DOCUMENT to AGGREGATE_ESTIMATE. The review extracted hypothesis results, ICC values, and SES values. These are summary estimates. Keep du1 and du3 as DOCUMENT because they concern search records and study documents.

Revise Finding f1 to state that missing-response proportions at or above the prespecified 5% problem threshold occurred in all five EQ-5D-Y-3L dimensions among children and in no dimensions among adolescents. State that this threshold occurred in three EQ-5D-Y-5L dimensions in each age group. Do not state that adolescents had no missing responses, because Table 2 reports missing responses below 5%. Add WITHIN_PERSON to the comparison structure because the same participants completed both EQ-5D-Y versions and paired responses were analysed. Add BETWEEN_GROUP because the study compared healthy and sick participants and compared age groups. Add a separate StudyFactor for continuous age in years with role EXPOSURE_OR_DETERMINANT; keep the existing age-group factor as STRATIFIER. Change Outcome o3 from PREFERENCE_OR_UTILITY to MEASUREMENT_PROPERTY because its reported outcome is empirical validity and relative efficiency of instrument scores, not participant preferences or utility levels as health outcomes.
